notes.title: Minor Update: Microphone Support & QoL Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've just rolled out a small update to address some of your feedback and add a new feature. Thank you for your continued support!

Here’s what’s new in this patch:

New Feature: Microphone Support

- We're excited to announce that microphone support has now been added to the game!

Quality-of-Life Improvements

- The panel that appeared on the left side of the screen when taking a screenshot has been removed for a cleaner, more immersive experience.

Bug Fixes

- Addressed several minor issues to improve overall stability and performance.

As always, please continue to share your feedback with us on the forums.
